title: Mittag-Leffler module via tensor products
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $P$ an $R$-module. The module $P$ is called Mittag-Leffler if, for every set $J$ and every family $(Q_j)_{j\in J}$ of $R$-modules, the canonical $R$-linear map $\theta_{P,(Q_j)}:P\otimes_R\prod_{j\in J}Q_j\longrightarrow\prod_{j\in J}(P\otimes_RQ_j)$, defined by $p\otimes(q_j)_j\mapsto(p\otimes q_j)_j$, is injective. Tensor products are [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]; the products here are modules of all families with componentwise operations.
